text_markup: If an "If successful" effect gives the Runner an effect they can optionally carry out instead of breaching, that decision is made at the time the breach would begin, in {ref:step_breach}.
text_plain: If an "If successful" effect gives the Runner an effect they can optionally carry out instead of breaching, that decision is made at the time the breach would begin, in step 6.9.5b.

examples.text_markup: The Runner plays {card:Account Siphon} while {card:Ash 2X3ZB9CY} is installed in the root of HQ, and the run is successful. The Runner can wait until after the trace from {card:Ash 2X3ZB9CY} completes before deciding to access cards normally or force the Corp to lose credits.
